commitments.quote: It applies to all agreements under which Business Associate creates, receives, maintains or transmits Protected Health Information for or on behalf of Covered Entity (the "Underlying Agreements").
commitments.summary: The BAA applies to every agreement under which Business Associate handles Protected Health Information for Covered Entity.
commitments.scope: All agreements under which Business Associate creates, receives, maintains or transmits PHI for Covered Entity.
commitments.deviation: BAA scope is keyed to PHI across Underlying Agreements; DPA 1.1 instead covers Customer Personal Data processed in providing the Services.

commitments.quote: Terms used but not defined in this BAA have the meanings given in the HIPAA Rules (45 C.F.R. Parts 160 and 164), including "Breach," "Discovery," "Protected Health Information" ("PHI"), "Electronic Protected Health Information" ("ePHI") and "Unsecured Protected Health Information."
commitments.summary: Undefined terms take their HIPAA Rules meanings, including Breach, Discovery, PHI and ePHI.
commitments.scope: Defines what counts as Breach, Discovery, PHI, ePHI and Unsecured PHI.
commitments.deviation: BAA incorporates HIPAA definitions rather than Data Protection Laws; DPA 1.2 defines Personal Data by reference to applicable Data Protection Laws.

commitments.quote: "Security Incident" has the meaning given in 45 C.F.R. § 164.304, limited to incidents involving ePHI that Business Associate or its Subcontractors create, receive, maintain or transmit for Covered Entity.
commitments.summary: Security Incident uses the HIPAA definition and is limited to incidents involving ePHI handled by Business Associate or its Subcontractors for Covered Entity.
commitments.scope: Security incidents involving ePHI that Business Associate or its Subcontractors create, receive, maintain or transmit for Covered Entity.
commitments.deviation: BAA uses the HIPAA security incident definition, which has no confirmation requirement, limited to ePHI; DPA 1.3 covers only Personal Data Breaches ExampleCo has confirmed.

commitments.quote: "Subcontractor" has the meaning given in 45 C.F.R. § 160.103.
commitments.summary: Subcontractor takes the HIPAA meaning in 45 C.F.R. § 160.103.
commitments.scope: Who counts as a Subcontractor under HIPAA.
commitments.deviation: BAA uses the HIPAA Subcontractor definition; DPA 1.4 defines Subprocessor as any third party engaged by ExampleCo that processes Customer Personal Data.

commitments.quote: Business Associate may use and disclose PHI only as necessary to perform the Underlying Agreements, as required by law, or as permitted by this BAA.
commitments.summary: Business Associate may use and disclose PHI only to perform the Underlying Agreements, as required by law, or as this BAA permits.
commitments.scope: PHI.
commitments.deviation: BAA permits use for the Underlying Agreements, legal requirements and this BAA; DPA 2.2 limits processing to documented customer instructions.

commitments.quote: Business Associate shall limit its uses and disclosures of PHI to the minimum necessary.
commitments.summary: Business Associate must limit its uses and disclosures of PHI to the minimum necessary.
commitments.scope: PHI uses and disclosures.
commitments.deviation: No DPA equivalent.

commitments.quote: Business Associate may de-identify PHI only in accordance with the safe harbor method at 45 C.F.R. § 164.514(b)(2), and may use the de-identified information only to provide and improve the services under the Underlying Agreements.
commitments.summary: Business Associate may de-identify PHI only by the HIPAA safe harbor method and may use the result only to provide and improve the services.
commitments.scope: De-identification of PHI under the 45 C.F.R. § 164.514(b)(2) safe harbor method.
commitments.deviation: BAA allows de-identification only by HIPAA safe harbor and use only to provide and improve the services; DPA 8.2 allows use of Usage Data to operate, secure and improve the Services.

commitments.quote: Information de-identified in accordance with this Section 2.3 is not PHI and is not subject to this BAA.
commitments.summary: Information de-identified under Section 2.3 is excluded from PHI and from this BAA.
commitments.scope: Information de-identified in accordance with Section 2.3.
commitments.deviation: BAA expressly excludes de-identified information from its coverage; DPA 1.6 defines Usage Data as aggregated or de-identified data and does not expressly exclude it from the DPA.

commitments.quote: A limited data set under 45 C.F.R. § 164.514(e) is PHI for all purposes of this BAA.
commitments.summary: Limited data sets are treated as PHI for all purposes of this BAA.
commitments.scope: Limited data sets under 45 C.F.R. § 164.514(e).
commitments.deviation: No DPA equivalent.

commitments.quote: Business Associate shall comply with Subpart C of 45 C.F.R. Part 164 with respect to ePHI.
commitments.summary: Business Associate must comply with the HIPAA Security Rule for ePHI.
commitments.scope: ePHI.
commitments.deviation: BAA requires compliance with the HIPAA Security Rule for ePHI; DPA 4.1 requires maintaining the Annex 2 measures, which ExampleCo may update.

commitments.quote: Business Associate shall not store, process or access PHI outside the United States.
commitments.summary: Business Associate may not store, process or access PHI outside the United States.
commitments.scope: All PHI, whether stored, processed or accessed.
commitments.deviation: BAA bars storage, processing and access outside the United States; DPA 6.1 keeps data at rest in the selected hosting region and DPA 6.2 permits access from outside it, including Manila.

commitments.quote: Business Associate shall maintain HITRUST r2 certification for the systems that store or process PHI.
commitments.summary: Business Associate must maintain HITRUST r2 certification for systems that store or process PHI.
commitments.scope: Systems that store or process PHI.
commitments.deviation: BAA requires HITRUST r2 certification; DPA 4.2 requires SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001 and does not mention HITRUST.

commitments.quote: Business Associate shall report to Covered Entity any Breach of Unsecured PHI without unreasonable delay and in no event later than ten (10) calendar days after Discovery.
commitments.summary: Business Associate must report any Breach of Unsecured PHI within 10 calendar days after Discovery, and without unreasonable delay.

deadline.anchor: Discovery of the Breach (defined by reference to the HIPAA Rules under Section 1.1)

commitments.recipient: Covered Entity's Privacy Office at privacy-office@ahs.example, with a copy to its Information Security Office at iso@ahs.example.
commitments.scope: Breach of Unsecured PHI.
commitments.deviation: BAA sets 10 calendar days from Discovery rather than 72 hours after ExampleCo confirms a Personal Data Breach. Inference, not stated in the contract: HIPAA Discovery generally runs from when the breach is known or should reasonably have been known.

commitments.quote: Business Associate shall report to Covered Entity any Security Incident within five (5) business days after Business Associate becomes aware of it.
commitments.summary: Business Associate must report any Security Incident within 5 business days after becoming aware of it.

deadline.anchor: Business Associate becomes aware of the Security Incident

commitments.recipient: Covered Entity's Privacy Office at privacy-office@ahs.example, with a copy to its Information Security Office at iso@ahs.example.
commitments.scope: Security Incidents as defined in Section 1.2, limited to ePHI.
commitments.deviation: No DPA equivalent. DPA 7.1 covers only confirmed Personal Data Breaches, with notice within 72 hours.

commitments.quote: This Section 4.2 serves as notice of, and no further report is required for, unsuccessful attempts such as pings, port scans and blocked log-in attempts that do not result in unauthorized access to ePHI.
commitments.summary: Section 4.2 serves as notice of unsuccessful attempts that do not result in unauthorized access to ePHI, and no further report is required for them.
commitments.scope: Unsuccessful attempts such as pings, port scans and blocked log-in attempts that do not result in unauthorized access to ePHI.
commitments.deviation: BAA treats these attempts as reported by Section 4.2 with no further report; DPA 1.3 excludes unsuccessful attempts from the Personal Data Breach definition, so no notice is needed.

commitments.quote: Business Associate shall report to Covered Entity any use or disclosure of PHI not provided for by this BAA within ten (10) calendar days after becoming aware of it.
commitments.summary: Business Associate must report any use or disclosure of PHI not provided for by this BAA within 10 calendar days after becoming aware of it.

deadline.anchor: Business Associate becoming aware of the use or disclosure

commitments.recipient: Covered Entity's Privacy Office at privacy-office@ahs.example, with a copy to its Information Security Office at iso@ahs.example.
commitments.scope: Uses or disclosures of PHI not provided for by this BAA.
commitments.deviation: No DPA equivalent.

commitments.quote: Reports under this Section 4 shall be made in writing to Covered Entity's Privacy Office at privacy-office@ahs.example, with a copy to its Information Security Office at iso@ahs.example.
commitments.summary: All reports under Section 4 must be made in writing to the Privacy Office, with a copy to the Information Security Office.
commitments.recipient: Covered Entity's Privacy Office at privacy-office@ahs.example, with a copy to its Information Security Office at iso@ahs.example.
commitments.scope: All reports under Section 4.
commitments.deviation: BAA sends reports to the Privacy Office with a copy to the Information Security Office; DPA 7.2 sends notice to the security contact designated in the Services administration console, or to the account owner if none.

commitments.quote: A report of a Breach shall include, to the extent known, the identity of each individual affected, the PHI involved, the date of the Breach and of its Discovery, and the steps taken to mitigate it.
commitments.summary: A Breach report must include, to the extent known, each affected individual's identity, the PHI involved, the Breach and Discovery dates, and mitigation steps.
commitments.scope: Reports of a Breach, with content limited to what is known.
commitments.deviation: BAA requires identities of affected individuals and the Breach and Discovery dates; DPA 7.3 requires the nature of the breach, categories of data and measures, not individual identities or dates.

commitments.quote: Business Associate shall reimburse Covered Entity's reasonable costs of notifying individuals, regulators and the media of a Breach caused by Business Associate or its Subcontractors.
commitments.summary: Business Associate must reimburse Covered Entity's reasonable costs of notifying individuals, regulators and the media for Breaches it or its Subcontractors cause.
commitments.scope: Breaches caused by Business Associate or its Subcontractors.
commitments.deviation: No DPA equivalent.

commitments.quote: Business Associate shall ensure that each Subcontractor that creates, receives, maintains or transmits PHI on its behalf agrees in writing to the same restrictions and conditions that apply to Business Associate under this BAA.
commitments.summary: Business Associate must ensure each Subcontractor handling PHI agrees in writing to the same restrictions that apply to Business Associate.
commitments.scope: Each Subcontractor that creates, receives, maintains or transmits PHI on Business Associate's behalf.
commitments.deviation: BAA requires a written flow-down of the same restrictions; DPA 5.5 makes ExampleCo responsible for Subprocessors' performance but has no written flow-down requirement.

commitments.quote: Business Associate shall make PHI in a Designated Record Set available to Covered Entity within ten (10) business days after Covered Entity's request, so Covered Entity can meet 45 C.F.R. § 164.524.
commitments.summary: Business Associate must make PHI in a Designated Record Set available to Covered Entity within 10 business days after its request.

deadline.anchor: Covered Entity's request

commitments.scope: PHI in a Designated Record Set.
commitments.deviation: No DPA equivalent.

commitments.quote: Business Associate shall make its internal practices, books and records relating to PHI available to the Secretary of Health and Human Services for purposes of determining compliance with the HIPAA Rules.
commitments.summary: Business Associate must make its internal practices, books and records relating to PHI available to the HHS Secretary for compliance review.
commitments.recipient: Secretary of Health and Human Services.
commitments.scope: Internal practices, books and records relating to PHI, for determining compliance with the HIPAA Rules.
commitments.deviation: BAA gives HHS direct access to internal practices, books and records; DPA 9.3 limits customer audits to one on-site audit per 12 months and treats the SOC 2 and penetration test reports as satisfying audit rights.

commitments.quote: On termination of the Underlying Agreements, Business Associate shall return or destroy all PHI within thirty (30) days.
commitments.summary: Business Associate must return or destroy all PHI within 30 days after termination of the Underlying Agreements.

deadline.anchor: Termination of the Underlying Agreements

commitments.scope: All PHI.
commitments.deviation: BAA requires return or destruction of all PHI within 30 days; DPA 10.1 allows 90 days after termination, with backups overwritten within a further 35 days.

commitments.quote: If return or destruction is not feasible, Business Associate shall extend the protections of this BAA to that PHI for as long as it retains it.
commitments.summary: If return or destruction is not feasible, Business Associate must keep extending the BAA's protections to the retained PHI for as long as it retains it.
commitments.scope: PHI that cannot feasibly be returned or destroyed.
commitments.deviation: No DPA equivalent.

commitments.quote: This VDPA prevails over the Subscription Agreement and over any data processing terms, policies or online terms of Vendor or its Affiliates.
commitments.summary: The VDPA overrides the Subscription Agreement and any Vendor or Affiliate data processing terms, policies or online terms.
commitments.scope: The Subscription Agreement and any data processing terms, policies or online terms of Vendor or its Affiliates.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 11.1 makes the DPA control only over processing of Customer Personal Data; this VDPA prevails over the whole Subscription Agreement and over Vendor Affiliate terms.

commitments.quote: all data that Retailer, its employees or its customers provide to Vendor or that Vendor collects from Retailer's systems, including telemetry, logs, traces and metrics, and all data derived from any of it.
commitments.summary: Retailer Data is defined broadly to include telemetry, logs, traces, metrics and all data derived from them.
commitments.scope: All data Retailer, its employees or customers provide or that Vendor collects from Retailer's systems, including telemetry, logs, traces, metrics and derived data.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 1.1 covers only Personal Data in Customer Data; this definition covers all Retailer Data, including non-personal telemetry, logs and derived data.

commitments.quote: any actual or reasonably suspected unauthorized access to, or acquisition, disclosure or loss of, Retailer Data, including while held by a Subprocessor.
commitments.summary: A Data Incident includes actual or reasonably suspected unauthorized access to or loss of Retailer Data, including data held by a Subprocessor.
commitments.scope: Actual or reasonably suspected unauthorized access, acquisition, disclosure or loss of Retailer Data, including while held by a Subprocessor.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 1.3 covers only breaches ExampleCo has confirmed and excludes unsuccessful attempts; this definition covers suspected incidents and Subprocessor-held data with no confirmation requirement or exclusions.

commitments.quote: any third party, including any Vendor Affiliate, that processes Retailer Data on Vendor's behalf.
commitments.summary: A Subprocessor includes any third party, expressly including any Vendor Affiliate, that processes Retailer Data for Vendor.
commitments.scope: Any third party, including any Vendor Affiliate, that processes Retailer Data on Vendor's behalf.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 1.4 covers third parties processing Customer Personal Data; this definition expressly includes Vendor Affiliates and covers all Retailer Data.

commitments.quote: Vendor shall process Retailer Data only to provide the services described in the Subscription Agreement (the "Services") and on Retailer's written instructions.
commitments.summary: Vendor may process Retailer Data only to provide the Services and on Retailer's written instructions.
commitments.scope: Retailer Data processed to provide the Services.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 2.2 allows instructions set out in the Agreement, the DPA and Customer's configuration; this requires Retailer's written instructions and limits processing to the Services.

commitments.quote: Vendor shall not use Retailer Data to train or improve any machine learning model, except models used only to provide the Services to Retailer.
commitments.summary: Vendor may not use Retailer Data to train or improve any machine learning model, except models used only to serve Retailer.
commitments.scope: Retailer Data used to train or improve any machine learning model, excluding models used only to provide the Services to Retailer.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 8.1 bars training only foundation models made available to other customers; this bars training or improving any machine learning model, with an exception only for Retailer-only models.

commitments.quote: Vendor shall store Retailer Data only in the United States or Canada.
commitments.summary: Vendor must store Retailer Data only in the United States or Canada.
commitments.scope: Storage of Retailer Data. The clause does not address access from other locations.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 6.1 stores data in the hosting region the customer selects; this fixes storage to the United States or Canada. Baseline 6.2 offshore access has no equivalent here.

commitments.quote: Vendor shall maintain administrative, technical and physical safeguards that meet or exceed the CIS Critical Security Controls, Implementation Group 2.
commitments.summary: Vendor must maintain safeguards that meet or exceed CIS Critical Security Controls Implementation Group 2.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 4.1 ties security to the measures in Annex 2 and allows unilateral updates; this requires a fixed external standard (CIS IG2) with no unilateral update right stated.

commitments.quote: Vendor shall encrypt Retailer Data at rest and in transit using industry-standard encryption.
commitments.summary: Vendor must encrypt Retailer Data at rest and in transit using industry-standard encryption.
commitments.scope: Retailer Data at rest and in transit.
commitments.deviation: Baseline Annex 2 specifies AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2 or higher in transit; this requires only unspecified industry-standard encryption.

commitments.quote: Vendor shall obtain a SOC 2 Type II report covering the Services each year and provide it to Retailer within fifteen (15) days after Retailer's request.
commitments.summary: Vendor must obtain an annual SOC 2 Type II report covering the Services and provide it to Retailer within 15 days after request.

deadline.anchor: Retailer's request

commitments.scope: SOC 2 Type II report covering the Services.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 4.2 requires a SOC 2 Type II report and ISO/IEC 27001 certification and 9.1 makes the report available through the Trust Center; this requires only SOC 2 Type II, delivered within 15 days of request and no ISO certification.

commitments.quote: Vendor shall not permit any Subprocessor other than those listed in Appendix B to process Retailer Data without Retailer's prior written consent.
commitments.summary: Vendor may not allow any Subprocessor not listed in Appendix B to process Retailer Data without Retailer's prior written consent.
commitments.scope: Subprocessors other than those listed in Appendix B.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 5.1 grants general authorization to engage Subprocessors; this requires Retailer's prior written consent for any Subprocessor not listed in Appendix B.

commitments.quote: Vendor shall request consent for a new Subprocessor in writing at least thirty (30) days before the Subprocessor begins processing Retailer Data. Retailer's silence is not consent.
commitments.summary: Vendor must request Retailer's written consent for a new Subprocessor at least 30 days before processing begins, and silence is not consent.

deadline.anchor: the Subprocessor begins processing Retailer Data

commitments.scope: New Subprocessors processing Retailer Data.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 5.2 gives notice of a new Subprocessor with an objection right; this requires a consent request and treats Retailer's silence as non-consent.

commitments.quote: Vendor shall bind each Subprocessor in writing to obligations at least as protective as this VDPA
commitments.summary: Vendor must bind each Subprocessor in writing to obligations at least as protective as this VDPA.
commitments.scope: Each Subprocessor.
commitments.deviation: No DPA equivalent.

commitments.quote: remains liable for each Subprocessor's acts and omissions.
commitments.summary: Vendor remains liable for the acts and omissions of each Subprocessor.
commitments.scope: Each Subprocessor's acts and omissions.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 5.5 makes ExampleCo responsible for Subprocessors' performance of DPA obligations; this makes Vendor liable for Subprocessors' acts and omissions in general.

commitments.quote: Vendor shall notify Retailer of a Data Incident without undue delay and no later than twenty-four (24) hours after Vendor becomes aware of it.
commitments.summary: Vendor must notify Retailer of a Data Incident within 24 hours after Vendor becomes aware of it.

deadline.anchor: Vendor becomes aware of it

commitments.recipient: Retailer Security Operations at secops@arg.example and +1 (614) 555-0182
commitments.scope: Data Incidents as defined in Section 2.3, including suspected incidents and incidents at Subprocessors.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 7.1 requires notice within 72 hours after ExampleCo confirms a breach; this requires notice within 24 hours after Vendor becomes aware of a Data Incident, including reasonably suspected ones.

commitments.quote: Vendor shall send notice by email to Retailer Security Operations at secops@arg.example and by telephone to +1 (614) 555-0182.
commitments.summary: Vendor must send Data Incident notice by email to Retailer Security Operations and by telephone to the stated number.
commitments.recipient: Retailer Security Operations at secops@arg.example and +1 (614) 555-0182
commitments.scope: Data Incident notices.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 7.2 sends notice to the security contact designated in the console or else the account owner; this fixes an email and telephone contact for Retailer Security Operations.

commitments.quote: Notice to Retailer's account or procurement contacts does not satisfy Section 6.1.
commitments.summary: Notice to Retailer's account or procurement contacts does not count toward the Section 6.1 notice requirement.
commitments.scope: Notice to Retailer's account or procurement contacts.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 7.2 falls back to the account owner when no security contact is designated; this excludes account and procurement contacts from satisfying the notice duty.

commitments.quote: Vendor's notice shall describe the Data Incident, the Retailer Data involved, any Subprocessor involved, and the steps Vendor has taken.
commitments.summary: Vendor's Data Incident notice must describe the incident, the Retailer Data involved, any Subprocessor involved and the steps taken.
commitments.recipient: Retailer Security Operations at secops@arg.example and +1 (614) 555-0182
commitments.scope: Content of Data Incident notices.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 7.3 describes only what is known and omits Subprocessor involvement; this requires the notice to describe any Subprocessor involved.

commitments.quote: Vendor shall supplement the notice as new information becomes available.
commitments.summary: Vendor must supplement the Data Incident notice as new information becomes available.
commitments.scope: Data Incident notices.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 7.3 says ExampleCo will provide further information as it becomes available; this is substantively similar and is listed here as the supplement duty.

commitments.quote: Vendor shall not inform Retailer's customers or any third party of a Data Incident involving Retailer Data without Retailer's prior written approval, except as required by law.
commitments.summary: Vendor may not inform Retailer's customers or any third party of a Data Incident without Retailer's prior written approval unless required by law.
commitments.scope: Data Incidents involving Retailer Data.
commitments.deviation: No DPA equivalent.

commitments.quote: Vendor shall cooperate with Retailer's investigation
commitments.summary: Vendor must cooperate with Retailer's investigation of a Data Incident.
commitments.scope: Retailer's investigation of a Data Incident.
commitments.deviation: No DPA equivalent.

commitments.quote: shall bear the reasonable costs of a Data Incident to the extent caused by Vendor or its Subprocessors.
commitments.summary: Vendor must bear the reasonable costs of a Data Incident to the extent Vendor or its Subprocessors caused it.
commitments.scope: Reasonable costs of a Data Incident caused by Vendor or its Subprocessors.
commitments.deviation: No DPA equivalent.

commitments.quote: Within thirty (30) days after the Subscription Agreement ends, Vendor shall delete all Retailer Data
commitments.summary: Vendor must delete all Retailer Data within 30 days after the Subscription Agreement ends.

deadline.anchor: the Subscription Agreement ends

commitments.scope: All Retailer Data.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 10.1 allows 90 days after termination or expiry and a further 35 days for backups; this requires deletion of all Retailer Data within 30 days with no backup carve-out.

commitments.quote: confirm the deletion to Retailer in writing.
commitments.summary: Vendor must confirm the deletion of Retailer Data to Retailer in writing.

deadline.anchor: the Subscription Agreement ends

commitments.scope: Deletion of all Retailer Data.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 10.2 requires certification of deletion only on customer request; this requires written confirmation of deletion without a request, within the same 30-day period.

commitments.quote: Retailer may audit Vendor's compliance with this VDPA once per calendar year on thirty (30) days' notice
commitments.summary: Retailer may audit Vendor's compliance with this VDPA once per calendar year on 30 days' notice.

deadline.anchor: calendar year

commitments.scope: Vendor's compliance with this VDPA.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 9.3 limits audits to one on-site audit per 12 months only where a supervisor requires it, on 60 days' notice; this grants an annual audit right on 30 days' notice without a supervisor trigger.

commitments.quote: within ten (10) days after notice following a Data Incident
commitments.summary: Retailer may audit Vendor's compliance with this VDPA within 10 days after notice following a Data Incident.

deadline.anchor: notice following a Data Incident

commitments.scope: Vendor's compliance with this VDPA, following a Data Incident.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 9.3 has no post-incident audit right; this allows an audit within 10 days after notice following a Data Incident.

commitments.quote: This VDPA binds and benefits each party's successors and permitted assigns.
commitments.summary: The VDPA binds and benefits each party's successors and permitted assigns.
commitments.deviation: No DPA equivalent.

commitments.quote: A change of control of Vendor, by merger, acquisition or otherwise, does not terminate or modify this VDPA.
commitments.summary: A change of control of Vendor does not terminate or modify the VDPA.
commitments.scope: Change of control of Vendor by merger, acquisition or otherwise.
commitments.deviation: No DPA equivalent.

commitments.quote: Any acquirer's standard terms do not apply to Retailer Data unless Retailer agrees in writing.
commitments.summary: An acquirer's standard terms do not apply to Retailer Data unless Retailer agrees in writing.
commitments.scope: Retailer Data.
commitments.deviation: No DPA equivalent.

commitments.quote: Appendix B: Approved Subprocessors
commitments.summary: Appendix B lists Amazon Web Services, Inc. (hosting, United States) and Helpdesk Platform, Inc. (support ticketing, United States) as approved Subprocessors.
commitments.scope: Subprocessors approved under Section 5.1.
commitments.deviation: Baseline has general authorization with a published Trust Center list; this contract uses a fixed approved list in an appendix.

commitments.quote: ExampleCo, Inc. (Vendor Affiliate) | Platform hosting and AI features for the Services | United States
commitments.summary: Amendment No. 1 dated September 8, 2025 adds ExampleCo, Inc., a Vendor Affiliate, for platform hosting and AI features in the United States.
commitments.scope: Platform hosting and AI features for the Services, in the United States.
commitments.deviation: Baseline 8.3 lists third-party model providers as Subprocessors and limits prompt retention; this adds a Vendor Affiliate for hosting and AI features and states no retention limit. The contract does not state that Retailer consented in writing to this amendment, which Section 5.1 would require (inference).

commitments.quote: This Addendum controls over any conflicting term of the Agreement, any order form, and any data processing addendum, privacy policy, or other document published or provided by Supplier.
commitments.summary: This Addendum overrides conflicting terms in the Agreement, order forms, and Supplier data processing addenda and other published documents.
commitments.deviation: DPA 11.1 makes the DPA control over the Agreement only as to processing of Customer Personal Data; this addendum overrides the Agreement, order forms and any DPA or other Supplier document for all Bank Data.

commitments.quote: Terms incorporated by reference to a Supplier website, including any Supplier trust or security site, do not bind Bank and do not modify this Addendum.
commitments.summary: Terms incorporated by reference to a Supplier website, including trust or security sites, do not bind Bank or modify this Addendum.
commitments.deviation: DPA relies on the Trust Center for the Subprocessor list (5.1) and the reports (9.1); this addendum states that Supplier website terms do not bind Bank.

commitments.quote: all data and information, in any form, that Supplier or any Subcontractor receives, accesses, creates or processes in connection with the Agreement, including (a) data provided by or on behalf of Bank or its customers; (b) metadata, logs and configuration data relating to Bank's use of the Services; and (c) any data derived from any of the foregoing, including model outputs, embeddings, annotations, and data that has been aggregated, de-identified, pseudonymized or tokenized.
commitments.summary: Bank Data covers all data in any form handled for the Agreement, including metadata, logs, model outputs, and aggregated or de-identified derivatives.
commitments.scope: Bank Data in any form, including metadata, logs, configuration data, and data derived from them such as model outputs, embeddings, annotations, and aggregated, de-identified, pseudonymized or tokenized data.
commitments.deviation: DPA covers only Personal Data within Customer Data; this covers all data in any form, including metadata, logs, and aggregated or de-identified derivatives.

commitments.quote: Supplier shall maintain a written information security program that is consistent with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and the FFIEC Information Technology Examination Handbook.
commitments.summary: Supplier must maintain a written information security program consistent with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and the FFIEC handbook.
commitments.deviation: DPA requires measures described in Annex 2 and lets ExampleCo update them if security is not materially reduced; this requires a program aligned with NIST CSF and the FFIEC handbook.

commitments.quote: Supplier shall encrypt Bank Data at rest using AES-256 or stronger and in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
commitments.summary: Supplier must encrypt Bank Data at rest with AES-256 or stronger and in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher.
commitments.scope: Bank Data
commitments.deviation: Same TLS 1.2 floor as Annex 2; at rest the standard is AES-256 or stronger, applied to Bank Data.

commitments.quote: Supplier shall require multi-factor authentication for all remote access to systems that store, process or transmit Bank Data.
commitments.summary: Supplier must require multi-factor authentication for all remote access to systems holding Bank Data.
commitments.scope: Remote access to systems that store, process or transmit Bank Data.
commitments.deviation: Annex 2 requires MFA for access to production systems; this requires MFA for all remote access to any system that handles Bank Data.

commitments.quote: Supplier shall complete a criminal background check on all Supplier Personnel before granting them access to Bank Data, to the extent permitted by law.
commitments.summary: Supplier must complete a criminal background check on Supplier Personnel before they access Bank Data, where law permits.
commitments.scope: Supplier Personnel, defined to include employees, contractors and agents of Supplier and of any Subcontractor.
commitments.deviation: DPA requires only written confidentiality obligations for authorized personnel; this adds a background check before access, to the extent law permits.

commitments.quote: Supplier shall maintain throughout the term of the Agreement a current SOC 2 Type II report covering the Services.
commitments.summary: Supplier must maintain a current SOC 2 Type II report covering the Services throughout the term.
commitments.scope: The Services.

commitments.summary: ExampleCo lists the third-party model providers used by AI features as Subprocessors on the Trust Center.
commitments.scope: Covers third-party model providers used by AI features.

commitments.quote: ExampleCo requires its model providers not to retain prompts or outputs beyond the time needed to return a response, except as required for abuse monitoring.
commitments.summary: ExampleCo requires its model providers not to retain prompts or outputs beyond the time needed to return a response, except for abuse monitoring.
commitments.scope: Covers prompts and outputs processed by model providers.

commitments.quote: ExampleCo will make its most recent SOC 2 Type II report available to Customer through the Trust Center, subject to Customer's acceptance of the Trust Center non-disclosure terms.
commitments.summary: ExampleCo will make its most recent SOC 2 Type II report available to Customer through the Trust Center, subject to Customer accepting the non-disclosure terms.

commitments.quote: ExampleCo will engage an independent third party to perform a penetration test of the Services at least annually and will make an executive summary of the results available through the Trust Center.
commitments.summary: ExampleCo will have an independent third party penetration test the Services at least annually and make an executive summary available through the Trust Center.

deadline.anchor: the prior penetration test

commitments.scope: Covers penetration tests of the Services.

commitments.quote: Customer agrees that the reports in Sections 9.1 and 9.2 satisfy any audit right under Data Protection Laws.
commitments.summary: Customer agrees that the reports in Sections 9.1 and 9.2 satisfy any audit right under Data Protection Laws.
commitments.scope: Covers the SOC 2 report and penetration test executive summary.

commitments.quote: Where a supervisory authority requires a further audit, Customer may conduct one on-site audit per twelve (12) month period, with at least sixty (60) days' written notice, during business hours, and at Customer's expense.
commitments.summary: Where a supervisory authority requires a further audit, Customer may conduct one on-site audit per 12-month period on at least 60 days' written notice, during business hours, at Customer's expense.

deadline.anchor: the on-site audit

commitments.scope: Applies only where a supervisory authority requires a further audit.

commitments.quote: Within ninety (90) days after termination or expiry of the Agreement, ExampleCo will delete Customer Personal Data from the Services.
commitments.summary: ExampleCo must delete Customer Personal Data from the Services within 90 days after termination or expiry of the Agreement.

deadline.anchor: termination or expiry of the Agreement

commitments.quote: Backups are overwritten in the ordinary course within a further thirty-five (35) days.
commitments.summary: Backups are overwritten in the ordinary course within a further 35 days after deletion from the Services.

deadline.anchor: the 90-day deletion period in Section 10.1 (inferred)

commitments.scope: Covers backups of Customer Personal Data.

commitments.quote: ExampleCo will provide written certification of deletion upon Customer's written request.
commitments.summary: ExampleCo will provide written certification of deletion when Customer requests it in writing.

commitments.quote: If this DPA conflicts with the Agreement, this DPA controls as to the processing of Customer Personal Data.
commitments.summary: If this DPA conflicts with the Agreement, this DPA controls as to processing of Customer Personal Data.
commitments.scope: Applies to processing of Customer Personal Data.

commitments.quote: Customer Data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
commitments.summary: Customer Data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
commitments.scope: Refers to Customer Data, which is not defined in this DPA.

commitments.quote: Access to production systems requires multi-factor authentication.
commitments.summary: Access to production systems requires multi-factor authentication.

commitments.quote: ExampleCo maintains a business continuity and disaster recovery plan and tests it at least annually.
commitments.summary: ExampleCo maintains a business continuity and disaster recovery plan and tests it at least annually.

deadline.anchor: the prior test of the plan

commitments.quote: Transfers of Customer Personal Data subject to EU or UK Data Protection Laws are made under the Standard Contractual Clauses, Module 2 or Module 3 as applicable.
commitments.summary: Transfers of Customer Personal Data subject to EU or UK Data Protection Laws are made under the Standard Contractual Clauses, Module 2 or Module 3 as applicable.
commitments.scope: Covers transfers subject to EU or UK Data Protection Laws.
